vIOS1#
vIOS1#configure terminal
Enter configuration commands, one per line.  End with CNTL/Z.
vIOS1(config)#no logging console
vIOS1(config)#ip access-list extended TEST_EX
vIOS1(config-ext-nacl)#no 5
vIOS1(config-ext-nacl)#no 5
vIOS1(config-ext-nacl)#no 5
vIOS1(config-ext-nacl)#no 6
vIOS1(config-ext-nacl)#no 6
vIOS1(config-ext-nacl)#no 30
vIOS1(config-ext-nacl)#5 permit tcp 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.20.0 0.0.0.255 eq 80
vIOS1(config-ext-nacl)#6 deny ip 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.2.0 0.0.0.255
vIOS1(config-ext-nacl)#30 deny icmp 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 192.168.20.0 0.0.0.255
vIOS1(config-ext-nacl)#40 deny udp 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 eq 23 192.168.20.0 0.0.0.255 eq 53
vIOS1(config-ext-nacl)#exit
vIOS1(config)#logging console
vIOS1(config)#end
